Rheumatology Follow-up
Patient: Anton Ivanova | DOB: 09/22/1979 | MRN: SYN-4642105
Date of service: 05/15/2025 | Dr. Adele Merriweather, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
45-year-old man with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2021, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: gastroesophageal reflux, type 2 diabetes.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 15 mg weekly for 29 weeks despite good adherence.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis with high disease activity, CDAI 36.
Pre-biologic screening: tuberculosis and hepatitis B screens negative.
Plan: start fictimab 160 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
